method: Compiled and executed both Python examples using constructed data; added a regression proving bool counts fail before applying the rate formula; ran deterministic checks against the article and metadata. No provider call was made.
limitations: The historical per-call prompts/responses, exact model snapshots and semantic scorer are unavailable; the historical omission and 8.1x token summaries were not reproduced.
The first fixture checks stable IDs and source IDs only; it does not evaluate natural-language meaning, source truth, or model compliance.
The rate example uses constructed counts, rejects non-integer/bool counts, and proves only local arithmetic; it does not validate a real business dataset or causal explanation.
No provider, production handoff, scheduler, authorization system, quality outcome, billing or latency was tested.
